office_does: The auditor runs county elections and voter registration, records documents and keeps the county's accounts; four-year term.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Auditor Robert J Waymire, in office for more than 11 years, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Skamania County Auditor for more than 11 years, running for re-election as a Republican; unopposed in 2022 and 2026.
highlights: Auditor for 11+ years; raised in the county [S1]
Promises professional, efficient and transparent service [S1]
